sections.title: Memes
sections.description: The July Meme of the Month results, kept in poll order and filtered to memes Lessons in Meme Culture covered in any upload from the past two months.

sources.label: Lessons in Meme Culture · past 2 months

items.title: Jimothy the raccoon
items.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
items.description: Jimothy is a wild raccoon with short spine syndrome who lives in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood. Videos of Jimothy spread across social media, inspiring works of fan art, memes and viral coverage in the media and with streamers and social media stars.
items.alt: Visual example of the Jimothy the raccoon meme

items.title: Kwebbelkop Laughing / YourRAGE Laugh
items.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
items.description: Kwebbelkop Laughing or YourRAGE Laugh refers to a viral sound effect of YouTuber and Twitch streamer YourRAGE loudly laughing in an exaggerated manner, which is often described as sounding like Dutch YouTuber Kwebbelkop. In 2026, the laugh became a trending sound on social media as it was used in memes, often depicting both YourRAGE and Kwebbelkop in different edits.
items.alt: Kwebbelkop portrait used with the viral laughing sound

items.title: Hatsune Miku World Cup Custody Battle
items.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
items.description: Hatsune Miku World Cup Custody Battle is a social game, meme and fan art trend that emerged during the 2026 FIFA World Cup in which social media users jokingly treat tournament matches as battles for the "custody" of the Japanese virtual singer Hatsune Miku. The joke proposes that whichever national team defeats the previous holder earns temporary "custody" of the Vocaloid character, inspiring artists to redesign Miku in the country's colors, clothing and cultural motifs until that team is eliminated.
items.alt: Visual example of the Hatsune Miku World Cup Custody Battle meme

items.title: Mbappé Special
items.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
items.description: Mbappé Special is a slang term and series of memes based on a viral video of French footballer and soccer star Kylian Mbappe saying, during an interview, that the "Kylian Special" is "for example, nothing," when asked what he likes to cook. The clip of Mbappe saying the Mbappe Special is "nothing" inspired memes that use the term as slang to replace the word "nothing" over the following weeks as it spread online.
items.alt: Visual example of the Mbappé Special meme

items.title: John Rod
items.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
items.description: John Rod is a nickname for an unnamed stand that appears in chapter 38 of the manga series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 9: The JOJOLands. The stand was popularized online in mid-July 2026, inspiring edits, fan art, memes and other fan content.
items.alt: John Rod from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

moreItems.title: Stay In Character
moreItems.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
moreItems.description: Stay In Character is a catchphrase and series of memes based on a scene from the 2026 Backrooms movie in which the protagonist, Clark (played by actor Chiwetel Ejiofor), yells, "Stay in character!" In June 2026, the film's scene became the subject of numerous memes on social media as the moment was used as an exploitable format with brainrot edits, recreations, Accuracy Reenactments and more.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of the Stay In Character meme

moreItems.title: Funky Ehh
moreItems.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
moreItems.description: We'll Drive A Funky Ehh or He'll Drive A Funky Ehh refers to a viral video of a kid claiming, during a game of Fortnite, that a remix of the song " Someone to Call My Lover " by Janet Jackson is by Oliver Tree, singing the song, "Maybe we'll meet at a bar, we'll drive a fancy ehh." A clip of the moment went viral on social media and Instagram Reels later that month, inspiring animations, remixes and memes based on the audio of the kid singing the song.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of the Funky Ehh meme

moreItems.title: Somebody Get These Beggars Out Of Here
moreItems.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
moreItems.description: Somebody Get These Beggars Out Of Here is a quote from the character Antinous, played by actor Robert Pattinson, in Christopher Nolan's 2026 epic fantasy movie The Odyssey, which appeared online shortly after the film's release in mid-July 2026. The scene is typically used online as a simple catchphrase and reaction meme to mock someone for being poor or begging for something, with the GIF or reaction image of Pattinson from the movie also being used as an exploitable in which creators add different visual elements to him.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of the Somebody Get These Beggars Out Of Here meme

moreItems.title: Homer Let the Barts Out
moreItems.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
moreItems.description: Homer Let the Barts Out is a brainrot and AI song by Rabadoonga about Homer Simpson letting a massive group of Bart Simpsons out of the house, who go on to cause uncontrollable destruction. It inspired memes on sites including social media, X / Twitter and Instagram Reels, including lip dubs, animations, covers and AI-generated videos.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of the Homer Let the Barts Out meme

moreItems.title: Best of Zach
moreItems.subtitle: July poll finalist · LIMC covered
moreItems.description: Best Of Zach refers to a series of memes about the Oney Plays video "Best Of Zach" and its thumbnail, which shows a cartoon drawing of Zach, also known as PsychicPebbles, over a pink background. In June 2026, a video that animates the video and sets it to an amateur rap song that repeats the words "best of Zach" was popularized online, inspiring further "Best Of Zach" memes.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of the Best of Zach meme

sections.eyebrow: 2025 annual slang review · by page views
sections.title: Slang
sections.description: Terms from Know Your Meme's latest annual slang review, ranked from most to least lifetime views on their Know Your Meme entries and checked against Urban Dictionary.

sources.label: Know Your Meme · 2025 annual slang review

items.title: 67 / Six-Seven
items.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
items.description: 67 Meme refers to a series of memes about a lyric in the song "Doot Doot" by Skrilla featuring G Herbo, a hip-hop song released in December 2024, that was popularized on social media and Instagram Reels in January 2025.
items.alt: The number 67 as used in the six-seven meme

items.title: Dead Rose Emoji
items.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
items.description: The Dead Rose Emoji refers to the 🥀 emoji that depicts a wilted rose. It's used online to represent being damaged or heartbroken, earnestly shared by emo internet users.
items.alt: Visual example of Dead Rose Emoji

items.title: Aura Farming
items.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
items.description: Aura Farming refers to an act of constantly trying to look "cool" or "badass" to build "aura moments." The expression is derived from the " aura " internet slang term and gained viral usage on X / Twitter, Instagram and social media in mid-September 2024.
items.alt: Stylized scene representing aura farming

items.title: SYBAU
items.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
items.description: SYBAU is a slang term and acronym meaning "shut your bitch ass up." The acronym has been used online since as early as 2003 when it was first defined on Urban Dictionary, spreading over the following years.
items.alt: Reaction image associated with the acronym SYBAU

items.title: Labubu Matcha Dubai Chocolate
items.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
items.description: Labubu Matcha Dubai Chocolate refers to a slang overload trend involving the overuse and spamming of trendy, mid-2025 fads and crazes like Labubu Toys, matcha drinks and Dubai Chocolate Bars.
items.alt: Visual example of Labubu Matcha Dubai Chocolate

moreItems.title: Clanker
moreItems.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
moreItems.description: Clanker is a slang term and a robophobic slur for droids and robots, originating from the Star Wars franchise. After initially appearing in the video game Star Wars: Republic Commando and The Clone Wars in the mid-to-late 2000s, the slang began seeing use online and in memes during the 2010s.
moreItems.alt: A battle droid associated with the slang term clanker

moreItems.title: TS PMO ICL
moreItems.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
moreItems.description: TS means “this shit”; PMO means “piss me off”; and ICL means “I can't lie”. TS PMO ICL, also spelled TSPMO ICL, refers to a Slang Overload trend of overusing slang abbreviations like TS, PMO and ICL, among others, to form nonsensical, brainrot posts that satirize the slang's use.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of TS PMO ICL

moreItems.title: Performative Male
moreItems.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
moreItems.description: Performative Male is an internet slang term used to describe a man whose actions, hobbies and personality traits appear inauthentic and seem to revolve around "performing" for other people's worldviews, tastes and interests, specifically catering to the female gaze.
moreItems.alt: Visual example of Performative Male

moreItems.title: Chopped
moreItems.subtitle: 2025 annual review term
moreItems.description: Chopped is a slang term with multiple definitions, but in memes, it predominantly means "ugly" when used to describe people. It's been used online since the early 2010s but gained a predominant presence online starting in the early 2020s.
moreItems.alt: Reaction image associated with chopped slang

sections.title: Movies
sections.description: Movie pages from last month's English Wikipedia topviews, kept in descending page-view order. IMDb ratings are shown as context but do not affect rank.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.subtitle: 2026 film
items.description: An action-adventure fantasy follows Odysseus, the Greek king of Ithaca, on a long and perilous journey home after the Trojan War. Along the way, he encounters mythical beings while trying to reunite with his wife, Penelope.
items.alt: The Odyssey 2026 theatrical poster

items.title: Obsession
items.subtitle: 2025 film
items.description: This horror-romance thriller follows Bear, a music store employee who buys a supernatural toy and wishes for his friend Nikki to fall in love with him. The wish comes true by making Nikki dangerously obsessed with him.
items.alt: Obsession poster or lead image

items.title: Project Hail Mary
items.subtitle: 2026 film
items.description: An adventure comedy-drama follows Ryland Grace, a middle school teacher who awakens aboard an interstellar spacecraft with no memory of how he got there. As he recovers his memories, he discovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance from killing Earth's sun, with an unexpected friendship possibly holding the key.
items.alt: Project Hail Mary poster or lead image

items.title: Backrooms
items.subtitle: 2026 film
items.description: This horror sci-fi thriller follows furniture store owner Clark and his therapist, Mary, after they discover a dimension of seemingly endless liminal spaces accessible through the store's basement. They must confront the implications of finding this strange hidden world.
items.alt: Backrooms poster or lead image

items.subtitle: Movie
items.description: The film follows a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander. After learning the truth about her family and stolen childhood, she joins her long-lost sister to bring down her creator and his illicit military program.
items.alt: Alpha poster or lead image

moreItems.title: Supergirl
moreItems.subtitle: 2026 film
moreItems.description: An action-adventure drama follows Kara Zor-El, or Supergirl, as she travels across the galaxy with an unlikely companion to pursue an adversary who harmed her pet dog, Krypto. Her mission becomes a journey of vengeance and justice when the threat strikes close to home.

moreItems.alt: Jana Nayagan poster or lead image

moreItems.title: Evil Dead Burn
moreItems.subtitle: 2026 film
moreItems.description: A fantasy horror mystery follows a woman who seeks solace with her in-laws after losing her husband. As the family members transform into deadites one by one, she discovers that vows made in life may demand survival even after death.
moreItems.alt: Evil Dead Burn theatrical poster

moreItems.title: Masters of the Universe
moreItems.subtitle: 2026 film
moreItems.description: An action-adventure fantasy follows Prince Adam after the lost Sword of Power resurfaces and reveals that the strange memories shaping his life are real. He returns to Eternia to challenge the tyrant who destroyed his family and kingdom.
moreItems.alt: Masters of the Universe poster or lead image

moreItems.title: Toy Story 5
moreItems.subtitle: 2026 film

Set two years after the previous story, the film centers on the toys' struggle with this new presence in playtime.
moreItems.alt: Toy Story 5 theatrical poster

items.title: Yesteryear
items.subtitle: Goodreads · Caro Claire Burke
items.description: Natalie Heller Mills, a traditional-lifestyle social media influencer, wakes up in the 19th century. She must learn to survive without modern society.
items.alt: Cover of Yesteryear by Caro Claire Burke

items.title: The Calamity Club
items.subtitle: Goodreads · Kathryn Stockett
items.description: In 1933 Oxford, Mississippi, Prohibition is on the wane, and the Great Depression is tightening its grip. And Charlie is a woman with a past, running low on luck but driven by fire, fury, and grit. Poor and rich folks alike have fallen on hard times, even as the old social order remains.
items.alt: Cover of The Calamity Club by Kathryn Stockett

items.title: Theo of Golden
items.subtitle: Goodreads · Allen Levi
items.description: One spring morning, a mysterious stranger named Theo arrives in the small Southern city of Golden. No one knows where he came from or why he is there, while his many questions leave the community searching for answers.
items.alt: Cover of Theo of Golden by Allen Levi

items.title: Mad Mabel
items.subtitle: Goodreads · Sally Hepworth
items.description: Eighty-one-year-old Elsie Mabel Fitzpatrick has lived on Kenny Lane for sixty years. With murder at the center of the story, her age and unassuming appearance may make her an unlikely suspect.
items.alt: Cover of Mad Mabel by Sally Hepworth

items.title: The Correspondent
items.subtitle: Goodreads · Virginia Evans
items.description: Letters from a woman’s past force her to confront one of the most painful periods of her life. She must find a letter she has written over the years and offer forgiveness before she can move forward.
items.alt: Cover of The Correspondent by Virginia Evans

moreItems.title: The Divorce
moreItems.subtitle: Goodreads · Freida McFadden
moreItems.description: Naomi believes she is living a quintessential love story until her husband expels her from their dream life, hires top divorce lawyers, drains their accounts, and begins seeing a younger woman. She must face the collapse of her marriage and security.
moreItems.alt: Cover of The Divorce by Freida McFadden

moreItems.title: Whistler
moreItems.subtitle: Goodreads · Ann Patchett
moreItems.description: When Daphne Fuller and her husband Jonathan visit the Metropolitan Museum of Art, they notice an older, white-haired gentleman following them. The man turns out to be Eddie Triplett, her former stepfather, who had been married to her mother for a little more than year when Daphne was nine. Whistler is a story about two adults looking back over the choices they made, and the choices that were made for them.
moreItems.alt: Cover of Whistler by Ann Patchett

moreItems.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl (Dungeon Crawler Carl, #1)
moreItems.subtitle: Goodreads · Matt Dinniman
moreItems.description: After every human-built structure on Earth collapses underground, survivors are forced into a sadistic intergalactic game show. Carl must crawl through a deadly dungeon, killing for survival while entertaining an audience he cannot escape.
moreItems.alt: Cover of Dungeon Crawler Carl (Dungeon Crawler Carl, #1) by Matt Dinniman

moreItems.title: Our Perfect Storm
moreItems.subtitle: Goodreads · Carley Fortune
moreItems.description: On the eve of Frankie’s wedding weekend, she does not know where she stands with George, her childhood best friend, or whether he will appear as her best man. Their passionate, impulsive friendship has always swung between conflict and reunion.
moreItems.alt: Cover of Our Perfect Storm by Carley Fortune

moreItems.title: Dolly All the Time
moreItems.subtitle: Goodreads · Annabel Monaghan
moreItems.description: At thirty-nine, Dolly Brick returns to Whitfield, Rhode Island, with her son for the summer after her mother left years earlier. She tries to keep her father and brother from losing the family home while confronting a situation that may begin as pretense but could become real.
moreItems.alt: Cover of Dolly All the Time by Annabel Monaghan
